title: Autonomous and Human-Driven Vehicles Interacting in a Roundabout: A Quantitative and Qualitative Evaluation
reasoning: The paper evaluates the impact of autonomous vehicles on traffic smoothness and safety perception through quantitative and qualitative analysis. While these aspects relate to human well-being and societal impact, the study does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as a primary focus or significant component. It is a technical evaluation of a transportation system and human interaction with it.
